text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand. This is important because clear code is simpler to maintain and less likely to contain bugs. Over time, quick fixes and shortcuts can create technical debt, which makes a project harder to work with. Refactoring helps reduce this debt by cleaning up messy sections and organizing the code better. Even though the behavior stays the same, the quality of the code improves, making future changes faster and safer for the whole team.
